item.title: Ex-NATO ambassador warns US and allies must 'stop the sniping' and unite to end Iran conflict
item.summary: Former U.S. Amb. to NATO Kurt Volker said the United States and its allies must "stop the sniping" and work together to end the conflict with Iran on "Fox News Live."

item.title: TEVI TROY: Trump faces the burdens of a wartime presidency
item.summary: How war reshapes the presidency: Trump's conflict with Tehran mirrors the experiences of Wilson, FDR, Johnson and Bush as wartime leaders, experts say.

item.title: World Series-winning manager gets emotional after learning on live TV his team will retire his number
item.summary: Ozzie Guillen was moved to tears as the Chicago White Sox announced they will retire his No. 13 uniform during a ceremony later this summer.

item.title: Blake Lively breaks silence after judge dismisses sexual harassment claims in Baldoni lawsuit
item.summary: Blake Lively breaks silence after judge tosses sexual harassment claims against Justin Baldoni, vowing to continue fighting retaliation at trial.

item.title: Daughters’ relentless search shatters ‘overdose’ claim, leads to arrest in mom’s 1992 murder
item.summary: James Robert Randle was arrested over 30 years after his estranged wife Janice was found dead in their Graham, Washington home in November 1992.

item.title: WWE's Sol Ruca 'content' with being at NXT for as long as management needs her
item.summary: Sol Ruca discusses her main roster goals and championship success in NXT ahead of her highly anticipated Stand & Deliver match versus Zaria.

item.title: Sen. Mike Lee urges Trump to invoke rare constitutional power to force Congress back from spring recess
item.summary: Sen. Mike Lee urges Trump to use a rare constitutional power to force Congress back from spring recess to address DHS funding and pass the SAVE America Act.

item.title: Golf legend rips Tiger Woods, PGA Tour after DUI arrest
item.summary: Golf legend Nick Faldo on Friday ripped Tiger Woods and the PGA Tour over DUI arrest, saying there must be accountability beyond offering support and treatment.

item.title: Luxury hotels launch superyachts for wealthy travelers who have long avoided cruises
item.summary: Luxury brands like Four Seasons and Ritz-Carlton are launching super-yachts designed to lure wealthy travelers who have traditionally avoided cruise ships.

item.title: Geno Auriemma releases statement after shouting match with Dawn Staley: 'Unlike what I do'
item.summary: UConn coach Geno Auriemma apologized for his heated postgame exchange with South Carolina's Dawn Staley after the women's basketball Final Four game.
